messages:
sre-oncall: alert: na2 apiserver 5xx spike after a big GPU pool churn at 11:03 UTC. controller-manager flapped leader twice.
mica: pulling dashboards. any SNAT/conntrack alerts?
infra-bot: alert: conntrack_full na2 = true, ephemeral_port_headroom = 2 / 16384 :warning:
jon: looks like a scheduled training job launched lots of pods; cluster-autoscaler added ~90 GPUs in ~3m. Pods all hit control plane to fetch configs.
elaine: kube-proxy logs: 
```
E0415 11:03:27.001 conntrack.go:212] conntrack: table full, dropping
```
jon: chain hypothesis: rapid node attach -> many kubelet control connections -> conntrack table + ephemeral ports exhausted -> apiserver accept queue pressure -> 503s and leader renewal jitter in etcd.
mica: mitigation: 1) pause autoscaler scale-ups for na2 (30m), 2) bump conntrack max and ephemeral port range on nat nodes, 3) move etcd leader off noisy host.
jon: applying sysctl on NAT gateways: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=300000`. Rolling.
elaine: marking na2-c-02 unsched for control-plane; requesting leader transfer.
infra-bot: route update: control-plane-canary -> na2-a applied :white_check_mark:
mica: leader moved to na2-a-01, etcd commit latency back to normal ~25ms. apiserver 5xxs declining.
sre-oncall: conntrack usage dropping after sysctl and hold. controller-manager stable.
jon: follow-ups: - add autoscaler startup smear, - add ephemeral port headroom alert (p1), - default conntrack bump for GPU clusters, - RFC for autoscaler safety limits.
mica: creating incident ticket and scheduling 30m postmortem. tagging ENG-PLATFORM and COST.
sre-oncall: will close when metrics stable. :thumbsup:
__notes: Single Slack thread about NA region apiserver 5xxs caused by rapid GPU autoscaler scale-up leading to conntrack and ephemeral port exhaustion; contains mitigations and follow-ups.
